translations.web: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’
translations.bsb: ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. So he told them, ‘You also go into my vineyard.’
translations.kjv: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
translations.asv: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard.
